native/budget-month.skip: Native iOS bridge read (sc-3584, ADR 11); MCP reads the same month through get_budget_month

native/schedules-paychecks.skip: Native iOS bridge read (sc-4341, ADR 11); MCP reads the same data through list_paychecks and get_paychecks_clearing_status

native/undo.skip: Native iOS bridge undo of a native write by its token (sc-4341); MCP writes record no native token; MCP undoes its own writes by audit id with write_undo (sc-4215)

native/paycheck-preview.skip: Native iOS bridge read of an editor draft (sc-4343, ADR 11); MCP reads paychecks through list_paychecks

native/paycheck-save.skip: Native iOS bridge write (sc-4343); paychecks are not in the MCP v1 write set (mcp-server "Write tools")

native/reconcile-month.skip: Native iOS bridge read of the Reconcile checklist (sc-4801, ADR 11); MCP reads each account's reconcile status through get_account_reconciliation

native/reconcile-rows.skip: Native iOS bridge read of the rows to tick (sc-4801, ADR 11); MCP reads rows through list_transactions and the cleared balance through get_account_reconciliation

native/reconcile-tick.skip: Native iOS bridge write of a person ticking rows (sc-4801); MCP sets cleared through write_update_transactions

native/accounts-list.skip: Native iOS bridge batched read of the Accounts list (sc-4386, ADR 11); MCP reads accounts through list_accounts and get_account_balance

native/account-register.skip: Native iOS bridge keyset-paged read of one account's register (sc-4386, ADR 11); MCP reads transactions through list_transactions

native/reconcile-list-set.skip: Native iOS bridge write of the person's own Reconcile checklist exclusions (sc-4801); a display preference, not budget data

native/reconcile-matches.skip: Native iOS bridge read of Reconcile step 3's likely matches (sc-4825, ADR 11); MCP reads rows through list_transactions

native/reconcile-lock-preview.skip: Native iOS bridge read of what a reconcile locks (sc-4825, ADR 11); MCP's write_reconcile_account returns the same in its dry run

native/reconcile-adjust.skip: Native-only: a person's confirmed reconciliation adjustment (sc-4825, design D4); no MCP tool or api/ handler creates an adjustment

native/reconcile-lock.skip: Native-only: a person's lock from the app (sc-4825, design D5); MCP locks through write_reconcile_account

native/transactions-categorize.skip: Native iOS bridge write of a person categorizing register rows (sc-4931, design D3); MCP sets categories through write_update_transactions

native/transactions-delete.skip: Native iOS bridge write of a person deleting register rows (sc-4931, design D3); MCP deletes through write_delete_transactions

native/account-reopen.skip: Native iOS bridge wrapper of account-reopen with an undo token (sc-4931, design D3); MCP reopens accounts through write_reopen_account

native/account-move.skip: Native iOS bridge wrapper of account-move with an undo token (sc-4931, design D3); a display order, MCP orders accounts through write_update_account

native/transaction-form.skip: Native iOS bridge batched read of the Add transaction sheet (sc-3602, ADR 11); MCP reads accounts, categories and transactions through list_accounts, list_category_groups and list_transactions

native/payees.skip: Native iOS bridge payee picker search (sc-3602, ADR 11); MCP reads payees through list_payees

native/transaction-preview.skip: Native-only: the Add transaction sheet's preview of a person's draft, which writes nothing (sc-3602, design D2); MCP writes transactions through write_create_transactions

native/settings.skip: Native iOS Settings read (sc-4643, native-settings-screen D1); MCP reads settings through get_settings in the mcp-settings-tools change

native/server-info.skip: Native iOS About server check with its own deadline (sc-4643, native-settings-screen D1); not an MCP capability

native/settings-save.skip: Native iOS bridge wrapper of the engine settings save with an undo token (sc-4643, D1); MCP will write settings through write_update_settings, which calls the same engine function
